variants.candidate: You learn slowly and for keeps, which is why you are the one people bring the questions that need time, whether you have the time or not.
variants.original: Your mind takes things in slowly and keeps them forever, and your best judgments are the ones you let sit overnight.

variants.candidate: You act by caring for what you already have, so you end up richer in what you kept but poorer in what you never tried.
variants.original: You act by cutting away whatever wastes the light, and what you care for slowly ends up bearing fruit that careless hands never get.

variants.candidate: Speaking and making are how the pressure in you leaves, so a week without either shows in your mood, whether you noticed the quiet or not.
variants.original: Your precision leaves you as flow, and the things you finally say arrive so smooth nobody sees how long you sharpened them.

variants.candidate: Rules only hold you when there is heat in them, so you do your best work under a deadline but your worst under a plan with no date on it.
variants.original: Pressure is your forge, and the heat you choose on purpose finishes an edge that comfort would have left dull.

variants.candidate: Your stamina is the kind that shows no wear until it fails, so you find out you were tired by stopping, whether you chose to stop or not.
variants.original: You bend for nothing and call it strength, and your body keeps that bargain until the day it presents the bill.
